old_problem: Correctable criteria contradict two immediate resets; proprietary direction semantics are unproven, copied selectors do not establish OCP identity, and the tested interface may be the lost management path.
disposition_reason: OCP topology can be a runtime manifest, but it cannot decide what errortype2/3 means or whether correctable ECRC must reset. Those core command/outcome semantics require vendor and platform authority under ED-03/12/16/18. The absent independent recovery channel makes execution unsafe. Pending/BLOCKED therefore remains until the contradiction and both recovery cycles are approved.

test_case.test_name: OCP ECRC TX/RX durable reset and service recovery
test_case.purpose: For each approved OCP module, validate authoritative TX and RX ECRC stimuli as separate durable reset cycles and restore the module, interface and dependent services after each.
required_package: Independent OOB and durable AER/BMC/UEFI evidence
Two-cycle boot/reimage, interface/service and configuration recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: Do not execute or force reset. After approval, isolate one mapped OCP path, capture durable pre-state, run one authorized TX stimulus once and close reset/boot/service recovery; only from a restored baseline separately authorize RX; restore and diff all settings after each cycle.
test_case.expected_result: Each direction produces the signed ECRC source/severity and expected containment/reset response; evidence survives reboot; host, OCP driver/link/interface and services return to baseline within approved deadlines before the next cycle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without authoritative flag and reset semantics. Tool PASS, copied tuple, volatile post-boot log, wrong direction/source, unexpected/no reset, lost management, incomplete TX recovery, boot loop or degraded service fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with management independent of the OCP interface.
Quiesce all management/storage/fabric traffic and verify live module path.
One direction once; RX forbidden until TX closure.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash evidence.
expected_evidence: Vendor contract and OCP dependency map
TX reset/boot/service record and recovery closure
RX reset/boot/service record and recovery closure
test_case.recovery: Must cover expected/no-reset/unexpected-reset outcomes, boot-loop/reimage escape, OCP link/interface/service restoration and exact AER/BIOS/HDT rollback over independent OOB. Execution remains blocked until approved.
